title: Scope alpha readiness blockers to readiness section
summary: Alpha bundle validation should only satisfy readiness blocker evidence from the Alpha Readiness section so copied blocker ids elsewhere in validation.md cannot satisfy blocker review.
expectedFailureModes: A readiness blocker copied outside Alpha Readiness satisfies bundle validation.
A bundle can omit blocker ids from the Alpha Readiness section but still validate.
Docs imply blocker ids anywhere in validation notes are enough.
humanEscalation: Published bundle format changes require human approval once real public release evidence exists.
nextAction: Parse the Alpha Readiness section explicitly, validate readiness blockers only from that section, add regression coverage, and document the section-scoped blocker contract.
